 Order
In this petition, there is challenge to an order dated 18.10.2021 contained in Annexure P/5.

The grievance as expressed by the petitioner is as regards the acquisition of his land without granting compensation and in lieu thereof there was a proposal to extend the benefit of Floor Area Ratio.
It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not willing to accept the offer which has been extended by the respondents in the impugned order.

Shri Pawar, who has entered appearance on behalf of the respondent No.2 submits that at present,
there is no proposal to acquire the land of the petitioner.

He, while taking this Court to the last paragraph of the impugned order, submits that a perusal of the impugned order reflects that if in future, the land of the petitioner is required for the purpose of widening of the road, in the terms of Section 305 of the M.P. Municipal Corporation Act, the present petitioner would be extended the benefit of Floor Area Ratio.
He submits that the petitioner has approached this Court at a premature stage, inasmuch as the land of the petitioner is not being acquired at present.

In view of the statement made by Shri Pawar, and also upon taking into consideration the apprehension of the petitioner, the present petition stands disposed of with an observation that if in future, any stand is taken by the respondents to acquire the land of the petitioner, the claim of the petitioner as regards the compensation would be considered without being influenced by the impugned order dated 18.10.2021 contained in Annexure P/5.
With the aforesaid, the petition stands disposed of.
